standfirst: The five genera left after Carlavirus was split out: Foveavirus, Robigovirus, Banmivirus, Ravavirus and Sustrivirus. All share the replicase / triple-gene-block / coat protein / NABP layout — organisation alone would have kept Carlavirus with them, and measurement is what separated them.

modules.Quinvirinae: Split from Carlavirus on 24 September 2026 on routing, not organisation. Lumped, 25 references reach 81.0%; the cost fell on every genus because Carlavirus has 102 clusters over 714 genomes and consumed a budget the smaller genera needed. Split, Robigovirus goes 81.8% to 100% and Foveavirus reaches 92% on five references.

gaps: 89 source strings reached no collection. Reconstructed from the collections as shipped, so sequences dropped on length, ambiguity or a cleavage check count as unbound.
